privacy.body.accountData: Registration, sign-in and profile updates process usernames, display names, email addresses, QQ numbers, linked EA player names and Persona IDs, roles and relevant timestamps. Community account passwords are stored as password hashes. Registration and last sign-in IP addresses are recorded. Email is used for registration verification, password recovery, sign-in and case notifications.
privacy.body.botBinding: Binding the official QQ bot or HeyChat bot processes platform OpenIDs or user IDs, group or room and channel IDs, the associated site user or group, the binding initiator, verification events and management policies. Bots use these associations to verify permissions, answer commands, send notifications and perform management actions you are authorized to request.
privacy.body.botEvents: To process platform deliveries reliably and prevent duplicate replies, bot event queues may temporarily store received events, message content and delivery results. If a group enables interaction observation, identifiers for groups, members or users and the times of received interactions are also recorded and expire according to the settings. This does not mean the bot receives every ordinary group message.
privacy.body.browserStorage: localStorage retains language, theme, recent player-query history and server-monitor preferences. sessionStorage retains the current authorization state, sign-in method and post-login destination. You can clear this local data through the relevant page or browser settings. Some preferences will need to be set again, and affected sessions may require sign-in or verification again.
privacy.body.captchaProviders: Depending on site configuration and your selection, verification loads scripts from Cloudflare Turnstile, hCaptcha, Google reCAPTCHA or GeeTest. The backend submits the verification token and, where applicable, the request IP to that provider. Script loading and challenge interactions also connect your browser to the provider, whose own privacy information applies to what it receives.
privacy.body.caseData: Cases store their type, linked player, rich-text body, evidence URLs, creator, handlers, status, replies and change history. Bot tickets also retain the platform user ID, nickname, avatar, original messages, timestamps and archived attachments needed to handle the case. Cases and archived evidence remain after the platform channel closes or is deleted. Archived files require case access. Rich text is filtered, but images and links may lead to external sites. Submit only relevant information and avoid unrelated personal data or account credentials.
privacy.body.caseNotifications: Depending on the case source and enabled notifications, replies or handling information may be emailed to relevant users or synchronized to the case’s linked KOOK or Discord platform. HeyChat volunteer-channel reminders contain a case identifier and a site link, without the case body. Personal status notifications and in-platform queries follow their own permission rules.
privacy.body.caseVisibility: Case visibility depends on its type, creator, role permissions and volunteer assignment. Creators and appropriately authorized administrators, volunteers or community roles can access cases under those rules. Do not assume every case is visible only to you.
privacy.body.cookies: The site uses sign-in cookies to maintain sessions, and OAuth-flow, visitor-identifier and verification-pass cookies to protect authorization and restore access. Their lifetimes and scope depend on the sign-in method, runtime configuration and relevant flow. Disabling necessary cookies may prevent sign-in, authorization or access verification from working.
privacy.body.eaVerification: EA identity verification can use an email address and EA ID, or the EA email address and password you submit. If you choose password verification, the backend verifies identity through EA authentication services to obtain the corresponding player details. This is separate from your community account password.
privacy.body.externalResources: Game queries, third-party sign-in and bot operations send the identifiers, parameters or messages needed by the feature to EA, Gametools, KOOK, Discord, HEYBOX, Steam or the relevant bot platform. Community avatars sync only from EA or linked and authorized HEYBOX, KOOK and Discord accounts; custom avatar URLs are not accepted. Loading external avatars, evidence images or other resources, or opening links to platforms such as BFBAN, sends browser requests to those providers. The home page embeds a Bilibili player, which sends requests to Bilibili when loaded.
privacy.body.gameSnapshots: Background services can retrieve server details, player lists and blocked lists in batches through Blaze and retain temporary snapshots. BFBAN status also has a temporary cache for background moderation. These support monitoring, scheduling and anti-cheat. Game names, player IDs and related status may appear in query results or community records according to the applicable access permissions.
privacy.body.oauthData: When you choose KOOK, Discord, HEYBOX or Steam sign-in or linking, your browser goes to that platform. The backend processes its authorization result, external user ID and necessary display name or public profile, then links that identity to your community account. Steam sign-in also checks the linked EA identity. Authorization state, browser association and confirmation results are handled as temporary transactions. Available providers depend on site configuration.
privacy.body.openingCredentials: The account-based server-opening page also saves the account details and remid and sid sign-in credentials you enter in the current browser’s localStorage. Signing out of the community does not automatically clear these details. Do not save such credentials on shared devices. Remove them by clearing the site’s corresponding local storage.
privacy.body.queryData: Player, stats and server queries send entered names, player IDs, server IDs and required parameters to our backend, which contacts EA, Gametools or configured query services as needed. BFBAN status is read from our local mirror and may have a synchronization delay. Results can include stats, weapons, vehicles, avatars, platoons, server and player lists, and community or anti-cheat status. Some basic player information also supports account and case associations.
privacy.body.requestSafety: Identify the account, player ID or record concerned and explain your request. Do not submit passwords, login cookies, two-factor authentication secrets or verification codes in tickets.
privacy.body.requests: You can use existing profile-update and unlinking features on account or group pages. Submit requests to inquire about, access, correct or delete personal information through a site ticket, or consult site help first. Identity and your relationship to the account or data must be verified before processing. We will explain the scope we can address after considering associated cases, permissions and necessary handling records, and may ask for more information. Submitting a ticket may require sign-in.
privacy.body.retention: Retention rules differ by data type. Verification records, counters, caches and events with expiry settings are cleaned up according to those settings; cleanup may not finish at the exact expiry time. Accounts, cases, bindings and operation records do not have one uniform automatic-deletion period. Closing a case, unlinking an account or clearing browser data does not delete every server record. Use the site contact options below to ask about specific retention or request deletion.
privacy.body.riskStorage: Visitor counters store keyed digest identifiers and counts, rather than raw IP addresses, User-Agents, request bodies or cookies in that counter store. Verification replay-prevention records retain digests of tokens or challenges. Registration and sign-in records, infrastructure logs and third-party verification processing are separate from these counters; this does not mean the site does not process IP addresses.
privacy.body.scope: This policy covers the BFV ROBOT website and its related account, query, case and bot features. Information is used to provide the features you choose, verify identity and permissions, handle community matters, send related notifications and prevent service abuse. Data processing varies by feature. Reading this page does not require sign-in.
privacy.body.serverStorage: Server-side persistent storage holds accounts and linked identities, game service account credentials, cases and replies, group and bot bindings, permissions and configuration-operation records. Registration verification, authorization transactions, verification replay prevention, visitor counters, server and blocked-list snapshots, BFBAN caches and bot events use their respective temporary storage, caches or queues. Operations staff and people with the relevant service permissions can handle data within their responsibilities.
privacy.body.serviceAccounts: Game service accounts configured by developers store email addresses, passwords or login cookies, two-factor authentication secrets, access and refresh tokens, game entitlement status and assigned purposes on the server. These support automatic authorization renewal, game queries, Blaze caching and authorized server management. Do not include service account credentials in ordinary cases or public content.
privacy.body.serviceProviders: Hosting, network delivery and email services may also process the requests or notification contents needed to deliver these features, depending on deployment configuration. Third-party features are used according to the relevant action and site settings. This policy does not replace those providers’ own data-processing rules.
privacy.body.updates: This page is updated as features and data-handling practices change. Refer to the dates at the top for the current version.
privacy.body.visitorRisk: When visitor protection is enabled, the backend evaluates request risk using the request IP, User-Agent, a random browser identifier, request counts, bursts and repeated access patterns. Thresholds may trigger a human-verification challenge or temporary request limits. Eligible requests can continue after verification. Browser characteristics here primarily associate access and verification state with the same browser.

apiAccess.title: API access
apiAccess.description: Apply for API tokens for community applications or bots, and review scopes, quotas and application status.
apiAccess.safetyHint: A token does not expand account or server permissions. Server APIs require additional approval and still verify ownership, game entitlement and administrator authorization.
apiAccess.applicationHint: Only public-query access is selected initially. Request the scopes you need; developers may narrow scopes and limits.
apiAccess.subject: Applicant type
apiAccess.reasonHint: Use at least 10 characters to describe the application, use case and expected traffic. Do not include passwords or secrets.
apiAccess.chooseScope: Select at least one API scope.
apiAccess.scopeHint.query:read: Player, server, platoon and public community data. Excludes email reverse lookup and private information.
apiAccess.scopeHint.server:read: Valid server configurations and blocked lists owned by the current account only.
apiAccess.scopeHint.server:open: Use existing owned server configurations. This token cannot modify sign-in credentials.
apiAccess.scopeHint.server:manage: Kick, block or unblock a player and send in-game chat. Current management authorization is still required.
apiAccess.loadFailed: API access information is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
apiAccess.writeFailed: The result is unconfirmed. Refresh the records before taking another action; do not submit again blindly.
apiAccess.invalidResponse: The API access service returned an invalid response.
apiAccess.noRecordsHint: No records match the current page and filters.
apiAccess.oneTimeWarning: The full token is shown only once. You cannot view it after closing. Save it in a secure password or secret manager; do not share it or embed it in webpage code.
apiAccess.copyFailed: Automatic copy is unavailable. Reveal the token and copy it manually, then close this dialog.
apiAccess.revokeHint: New requests will be rejected after revocation. This token cannot be restored; apply again if access is still needed.
apiAccess.signInRequired: Sign in with an eligible community account
apiAccess.signInHint: Applications and tokens are available only to the eligible current account.
apiAccess.adminHint: Review community and bot applications, and manage expiry, rates, quotas and revocation.
apiAccess.adminSafety: Approval can grant only requested scopes and does not grant server ownership. Only the applicant can claim the plaintext token; developers cannot view it.
apiAccess.reviewHint: Grant only scopes included in the application. Initial limits and validity cannot exceed the requested values.
apiAccess.revisionHint: Changes check the current revision. If another developer has updated the token, close this dialog and refresh the list first.
apiAccess.expiryHint: Must be in the future and no more than 365 days from now.
apiAccess.developerOnly: Only unrestricted developers can review and manage API tokens.

qqGroup.description: Link multiple QQ chats to one community group. Configure admission, welcome messages, activity observation and message rules for each chat.

qqGroup.managerOnly: Only community group owners and administrators can view QQ chat settings.
qqGroup.addHint: Generate a one-time group code, then mention the bot and send the full command in the target QQ chat. Repeat to link other chats; no member OpenID is required.

qqGroup.readOnly: Read-only access. Owners and senior administrators can change policies and clean up members; only owners can add or unlink chats.

qqGroup.admission.title: Admission review
qqGroup.admission.healthy: Only players with healthy ROBOT and BFBAN status
qqGroup.admission.hint: Check the game ID supplied in the join questions. A verified community identity can identify its game account. Missing identity, answers or status will not be guessed.
qqGroup.admission.localHint: “Local blacklist or healthy players” uses OR: the player is on this community’s local blacklist, or both ROBOT and BFBAN statuses are healthy.
qqGroup.activity.title: Activity observation
qqGroup.activity.hint: Enable all-message reception for this chat in Tencent’s console. Store only each member’s last message time. Observation starts after the bot has joined and full reception is verified; gaps restart the period. Unobserved time is never counted as inactivity.
qqGroup.activity.waiting: Continuous observation is under 7 days or reception requirements are not met
qqGroup.moderation.title: Message moderation
qqGroup.moderation.hint: Uses plain-text matching, not regular expressions. Message recall requires Tencent authorization.
qqGroup.welcome.defaultHint: Until a custom template is approved, use the built-in format showing player information and ROBOT/BFBAN status.
qqGroup.welcome.title: Welcome message template
qqGroup.welcome.reviewHint: Changes take effect only after community administrator approval. While pending, keep using the previously approved or built-in template.
qqGroup.keywords.approvalHint: Only approved rules may send messages. Saving this switch does not approve pending content.
qqGroup.keywords.title: Keyword reply rules
qqGroup.keywords.reviewHint: Rules require community administrator approval and renewed review after changes. Use plain-text matching without regular expressions or scripts. Approved replies may include text links.
qqGroup.submitted: Submitted for review. New content will not be applied before approval.
qqGroup.cleanup.title: Inactive member cleanup
qqGroup.cleanup.safety: Requires at least 7 continuous days of all-message reception and a complete member directory. Use actual join time and the valid observation start; never count unobserved time. Owners, administrators and bots are excluded, and roles/latest activity are rechecked before removal.

qqGroup.cleanup.progressPaused: Progress polling paused. Refresh manually; the background task will not be resubmitted.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.description: Manage website and full-client notices, review cross-platform and in-game announcements, and inspect delivery results.

announcements.popupDescription: A community announcement. Dismissing it hides this version in this browser.
announcements.destinationDescription: Only registered, enabled destinations receive announcements. SMTP respects important-notice subscriptions; bots use developer settings. A KOOK bot service is not configured.
announcements.targetWarning: Select each group, channel or server explicitly. Website audience filters do not restrict who can read an external channel.
announcements.destinationWarning: Saving does not send a message. Enabling makes this destination selectable; changing or disabling it stops pending deliveries to the old target.
announcements.field.groupOpenId: QQ group OpenID (not its group number)
announcements.reviewWarning: Check the content, audience, dates and destinations. Approved content must return to draft and be reviewed again before changes can be published.
announcements.withdrawWarning: Withdrawing hides website / client notices and cancels pending deliveries. Accepted or in-flight messages cannot be recalled automatically.
announcements.publishWarning: Publishing creates durable delivery tasks. Check every destination and complete verification. Unconfirmed sends are not automatically retried.
announcements.typeTitle: Type the full announcement title to confirm
announcements.published: Announcement published. Check delivery status for external messages.
announcements.unknownResult: The result is unconfirmed. Refresh announcements and delivery records before taking another action.
announcements.deliveryWarning: Delivered means the provider confirmed acceptance, not that a recipient read it. Review items are not retried automatically; SMTP audiences expand in batches.
announcements.noDeliveries: No external deliveries for this announcement
announcements.networkLimit: Title and plain text together must fit 3,900 characters. Bots receive safe text.
announcements.gameLimit: Title and plain text together must fit 500 characters. Only configured, live community servers with verified ownership receive messages.
announcements.unavailable: Announcements are unavailable. Try again later.
announcements.forbidden: Only community administrators can manage announcements.

files.description: Manage externally stored files and temporary attachments.
files.storageNotice: Files are uploaded to external storage; the server keeps metadata only. Three and ten years are website retention periods, not platform guarantees. Download links are refreshed from the saved reference when supported.
files.sizeLimit: Maximum 8 MiB per file. Supports PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, PDF, plain text, ZIP and MP4.
files.loadFailed: Files are unavailable. Try again later.
files.uploadFailed: Upload did not complete. Check the file status and provider configuration.
files.deliveryUnknown: Delivery is unconfirmed. Refresh the status or ask an administrator to review it. Do not upload again. Verification requires a saved message receipt.
files.downloadFailed: The file link is unavailable. It may have expired or been removed by the provider.
files.discordNotice: Uses the existing Discord Bot Token and a dedicated server/text channel. Attachment URLs expire and can be refreshed while the message exists.
files.heychatNotice: Uses the existing HeyChat bot credentials. A dedicated room/text channel is checked before upload through the official media API. Images use image messages; other accepted files use attachment links. Supported types and retention depend on the platform response, and links may expire.
files.kookNotice: Uses dedicated bot credentials, server and text channel. Assets are uploaded before creating a file message.
files.secretNotice: Blank credentials keep their saved values. Checking clear deletes them; disable the provider first. Configured does not mean connection-tested.
files.ticketLinkNotice: Attachments use third-party links that may expire or be removed. Legacy sole archive copies are retained until external migration is verified.

通过网页开启精简版或进阶版服务器前，服主必须阅读并主动同意当前版本；同意记录会与: Before opening a Lite or Advanced server on the website, owners must read and explicitly accept the current rules. Acceptance is recorded with the community account, server configuration and rules version.
这些约定根据原文的公平运营要求重新编写，并扩展到网页开服。精简版的观察者连接由社: These rules adapt the source’s fair-operation requirements to web-based opening. Community services maintain Lite spectator connections, so owners do not need a permanently running personal PC. Advanced status requires manual community approval; owners cannot upgrade themselves.
服主负责保持公开规则准确、安排管理人员处理申诉并提供证据。不要将获得开服权限理解: Owners must keep published rules accurate, arrange administrators to handle appeals and supply evidence. Opening permission does not authorize arbitrary kicks, changes to player rights or punishments without a published basis.
相同情形采用相同规则，管理人员、群成员和付费或特殊身份玩家也不例外。发现作弊不得: Apply the same rules to the same conduct, including administrators, group members and players with paid or special status. Do not shelter cheaters or kick players without evidence of a violation.
不得为 VIP 腾位置而任意踢人，也不得让特定成员独占载具等公共资源。允许飞机的: Do not arbitrarily kick players to reserve VIP slots or give selected members exclusive access to shared resources such as vehicles. Servers allowing aircraft must not ban anti-aircraft combat or dogfights to grant one side an unfair advantage.
如果公布新手、等级或生涯数据限制，必须使用当前版本实际支持并启用的功能执行；精简: Published newcomer, rank or career-stat restrictions must be supported and enabled in the current version. Lite has no native rank, KD or KPM limits and must not claim otherwise. Advanced limits must be configured before they are advertised as active.
等级规则以社区提供的选项为准，采用不高于 200 级或不设上限；不得设置 300: Use the community’s supported rank options: a cap of 200 or lower, or no cap. Do not use caps such as 300 or 400 to indirectly exclude players. Kill restrictions and balancing should use community-verified software features, preferably recommended presets.
安排足够的管理轮班处理明显作弊、恶意破坏与突发事件，争取在同一局内、三十分钟内完: Arrange sufficient administrator coverage for clear cheating, deliberate disruption and incidents. Aim to act or provide clear feedback within the same round and within thirty minutes.
处理分歧时保持克制，说明对应规则、具体行为及申诉途径；不得利用管理权限报复、辱骂: Handle disagreements calmly and explain the applicable rule, specific conduct and appeal route. Do not use administrative powers for retaliation, abuse or unrelated disputes.
依据 ROBOT 与 BFBAN 当前有效的处理状态执行社区规则。对尚未定性的嫌: Apply community rules using the current valid ROBOT and BFBAN status. For unresolved suspicions, collect reviewable video, match reports and career data for assessment through the appropriate channels.
回收站、白名单以及已经完成自证的玩家，在没有新证据时按正常玩家对待，不得反复要求: Treat players in the recycle bin or whitelist, and players who have completed verification, as normal in the absence of new evidence. Do not repeatedly demand the same proof. Contact the community team with specific new evidence if you dispute a conclusion.
每次踢出、屏蔽及解除操作都应留下操作者、对象、时间、服务器与原因记录，保留必要证: Each kick, ban and unban must record the operator, target, time, server and reason. Keep necessary evidence and provide an accessible appeal route.
本地屏蔽必须针对本服务器发生的具体行为，说明原因、证据、有效期限和解除办法。: Local bans must address specific conduct on that server and state the reason, evidence, duration and removal procedure.
不得仅凭联合黑名单、无关服务器的争执或私人关系添加本地屏蔽。其他服务器提供的材料: Do not add local bans solely on the basis of shared blacklists, disputes on unrelated servers or personal relationships. Materials supplied by other servers still require independent review under your server’s published rules.
禁止歧视、针对个人的攻击、恶意政治挑衅和泄露他人隐私。严重开盒、歧视等情况应提交: Discrimination, personal attacks, deliberate political provocation and disclosure of private information are prohibited. Submit serious doxxing or discrimination to community review; the community decides whether global enforcement applies.
禁止辱骂、恶意嘲讽、恶意蹲起鞭尸以及蓄意打断队友救援。: Abuse, malicious taunting, repeated hostile teabagging or corpse abuse, and deliberate interruption of teammates’ revives are prohibited.
禁止破坏己方补给设施，或蓄意干扰己方正常行动。: Destroying friendly supply facilities or deliberately obstructing your own team is prohibited.
禁止向敌方送载具、干扰己方载具，或趁队友维修、短暂下车时恶意夺取载具。: Giving vehicles to the enemy, interfering with friendly vehicles or taking vehicles maliciously while teammates repair them or briefly get out is prohibited.
禁止攻击尚未完成起飞的敌机，以及在机场埋雷等利用起飞阶段制造不公平优势的行为。: Attacking enemy aircraft before takeoff is complete, laying mines at airfields and similar exploitation of the takeoff phase for an unfair advantage are prohibited.
禁止利用反器材步枪连发等游戏 BUG 获取优势。有关 BUG 和异常行为应保存证: Exploiting game bugs, including rapid-fire anti-materiel rifles, is prohibited. Preserve evidence of bugs or abnormal behavior and report it to BFBAN or the community through the applicable process.
一般行为争议由本服按事先公开的规则裁定，必须留档并允许申诉；不得把本地纠纷直接升: Ordinary conduct disputes are decided locally under rules published in advance. Keep records and allow appeals; do not directly escalate local disagreements into global penalties.
开服前必须确认同一开服账号、记录中的房间编号以及相关管理员没有仍在运行的旧服务器: Before opening, verify that the same opening account, recorded Game ID and relevant administrators have no existing active server. Close the old server and confirm it has disappeared first. Do not bypass checks by changing blueprints or request methods.
取得 Game ID 表示创建请求已有结果，管理员注入、房间分配与观察者连接仍可: A Game ID means the creation request has a result. Administrator injection, room allocation and spectator connections may still be preparing in the background. Check readiness instead of repeatedly submitting creation requests.
原文提出的专用常驻设备、专用游戏账号、观察者轮班、每月约十至十五天运营和至少五十: The source’s dedicated always-on device and game account, spectator shifts, roughly ten to fifteen operating days per month and bot group of at least fifty people are Full-edition admission references, not automatic extra conditions for web-based Lite. Current community review requirements govern Full and Advanced admission.
社区可根据可复核记录调查违规行为，并视情况暂停开服或管理权限；处理结果应提供说明: The community may investigate violations using reviewable records and suspend opening or management permissions as appropriate. Decisions should include explanations and a review route.

apiDocs.title: BFV ROBOT Public API
apiDocs.description:
Public endpoints for data queries, server hosting, and server management. Anonymous queries are subject to visitor risk checks and network limits. Apply for an API token before integrating automated clients.

Apply by signing in → API access → choose a community account or an account that already has the bot role, and describe the use, scopes, and limits → wait for developer review → claim the token once under My tokens. `/api/v2/api-access/requests` requires a website session. Website login credentials cannot be used as Bearer API tokens. Approval does not grant additional server permissions to the account.

Send `Authorization: Bearer robot_…`. Tokens are displayed once; only their hashes are stored. Revoke lost tokens and apply again. Expired or revoked tokens, disabled or restricted accounts, and removed bot roles are denied immediately. Daily quotas use UTC calendar days. All authenticated attempts count toward the daily quota, including attempts over the per-minute limit. On 429, respect Retry-After and back off; use bounded backoff on 503. If a hosting or write result is uncertain. Check its state first. Never retry writes blindly.

`server:*` scopes require additional approval and apply only to available server configurations owned by the current account. Hosting also requires valid configured credentials, game entitlement, and an injected administrator. Management operations continue to verify current ownership, entitlement, and administrator purpose. Unavailable prerequisites, including unfinished full-client offline takeover, return an error rather than a false success. Tokens do not grant access to administration, private cases, user credentials, developer settings, or internal bot endpoints.

apiDocs.legacyStreamDescription:
This endpoint is served directly at `/api/v2/player/streamPlayerStatus` (also `/api/player/streamPlayerStatus`), outside `/api/v2/public`. Use the fixed `auth` header provided separately by the community. An incorrect `auth` returns 403 without falling back. When `auth` is absent, the original website JWT in `x-access-token` is also accepted, but community role 2 or 5 is required. Ordinary API tokens and their scopes do not apply. Request credentials from community administrators.

Send `sortBy: "updateTime"` and an inclusive ISO 8601 time range. The actual database field is `lastModified`. `order` defaults to `asc`, `limit` to 100, and `skip` to 0. Synchronize in batches with `limit`/`skip`; `limit: 0` returns an empty body. The status filter applies to `operationStatus`; an omitted or empty array applies no filter.

Successful responses use NDJSON: one object per line, followed by a newline. Fields are `personaId`, `operationStatus`, `reasonStatus`, `reasonStatusName`, `operationStatusName`, and `lastModified`. SQL value types are preserved: identifiers and statuses may be numbers or strings, names may be null, and dates serialize as strings. No matches produce an empty body. There is no success wrapper, completion event, or final object.

Check HTTP status before parsing data. A failed first SQL batch can return 500 with an NDJSON Content-Type but a single error JSON object. SQL failures, timeouts, or request interruptions after rows have been sent abort the HTTP message without adding an error line. Clients must verify normal HTTP completion, message completeness, and complete JSON lines. Never treat a disconnected or incomplete response as finished; retry from confirmed progress using overlapping time windows. A fixed time window does not provide a database snapshot. Save progress using idempotent writes by PID and integrity checks. This endpoint does not provide hard-delete tombstones.
apiDocs.error.streamLimit: Request rate or concurrent stream limit exceeded
apiDocs.legacyKeyDescription: A compatibility credential configured through the server environment, with rotation and revocation support. Disabled by default; obtain it from community administrators for this endpoint only. Never put credentials in URLs, request bodies, or public examples.
apiDocs.error.streamRead: Request construction or SQL read failed; after partial output, the stream may simply end.
apiDocs.error.legacyForbidden: Invalid compatibility credential or required account role missing
apiDocs.error.streamParameters: Time range missing or sort parameters invalid
apiDocs.legacyStreamAuthorization: A separately issued compatibility credential, or an account with community role 2 or 5 when auth is absent
apiDocs.legacySessionDescription: The original website JWT, accepted only when auth is absent. Community role 2 or 5 is required; API token approval does not grant these roles.
apiDocs.streamResponse: Line-delimited JSON; no matches produce an empty body. Ends at EOF without a success wrapper.

guide.article.account.title: Register, sign in and recover an account
guide.article.account.summary: Choose registration or an existing account link, then verify your EA identity and email.
guide.article.account.audience: All players. Registration and password recovery require verification.
guide.article.account.section.register.b: Look up your EA player first. If you already have a community account, choose the existing-account option instead of creating a duplicate.
Enter a community username and password. Use an offered EA verification method: email and EA ID, or email and password. Community and EA passwords are separate fields.
Review the form, complete verification and submit. Follow the verification email, then return to sign in.
guide.article.account.section.recover.bo: Check spam, the email spelling and the resend cooldown. Use the resend-verification option rather than repeatedly submitting registration.
Reset a forgotten community password using the linked email. An account suspension requires a case review; resetting the password does not remove it.
guide.article.account.section.profile.bo: After signing in. Check your player ID, platform links and avatar source in your profile. Avatars sync from supported providers; custom image URLs are not accepted.
guide.article.oauth-bindings.title: Third-party sign-in, bot links and avatars
guide.article.oauth-bindings.summary: Understand OAuth sign-in, QQ bot identity and platform avatar synchronization.
guide.article.oauth-bindings.audience: Community users. Availability depends on provider configuration and authorization.
guide.article.oauth-bindings.section.oau: Sign in or link a provider
Use an enabled official provider button. Unconfigured or unavailable providers cannot complete sign-in; editing callback URLs will not bypass this.
If asked to link a community account, sign in to it and confirm the link. Do not repeatedly unlink an existing identity; keep the error text if linking fails.
Manage enabled KOOK, Discord and HeyChat links in your profile. Steam availability is shown on the sign-in page. Providers and community settings control scopes and callback domains.
guide.article.oauth-bindings.section.bot: A QQ number, QQ OAuth identity and official bot session identity are different inputs. Use the one-time linking command; do not enter a group-member OpenID manually. Basic queries are public; community and server actions require permission.
guide.article.oauth-bindings.section.ava: Choose EA, HeyChat, KOOK or Discord as the avatar source. A linked, supported provider is required; OAuth is requested when necessary. Syncing does not relink accounts, and an unconfirmed identity keeps the previous avatar.
guide.article.player-query.title: Look up players, stats and community status
guide.article.player-query.summary: Use an EA name or Persona ID to check stats, equipment, platoons and case records.
guide.article.player-query.audience: All visitors. Frequent requests may require verification.
guide.article.player-query.section.searc: Enter the full EA name or numeric Persona ID, submit once and wait. Prefer the Persona ID after a name change or when names are ambiguous.
Confirm the returned player ID and avatar before reading career, weapons, vehicles, gadgets and achievements. Missing values are not zero and are not evidence of cheating.
guide.article.player-query.section.statu: Gameplay statistics and community decisions are different information. A weapon anomaly needs context from samples, career data and evidence.
BFBAN status is read from the backend mirror and may lag a synchronization cycle. Check its source and time; unavailable or unknown does not mean clear.
guide.article.player-query.section.error: Check the spelling and platform, then try the numeric ID. For 503, authorization errors or an EA outage, avoid rapid retries and report the time, queried ID and error text.
guide.article.server-query.title: Find servers and read server details
guide.article.server-query.summary: Search by name, map or region, and understand player counts and snapshot times.
guide.article.server-query.audience: All visitors. Management actions require separate authorization.
guide.article.server-query.section.filte: Enter a name keyword, then use the available region, map and mode filters. New searches start on page one.
Use pagination instead of loading every server. Open a result to inspect players, ownership and community registration details.
guide.article.server-query.section.roste: The main player count excludes spectators. Available platoon tags appear as [tag]name. Server pages use published snapshots and do not fetch career KD/KPM for the entire roster; query a player separately when needed.
guide.article.server-query.section.fresh: Follow the displayed status and update time when snapshots are unavailable or incomplete. Refreshing cannot fix an EA or Blaze outage. Viewing a server does not grant kick, hosting or messaging permissions.
guide.article.lite-hosting.title: Lite hosting: configure, start and manage
guide.article.lite-hosting.summary: Prepare the host account, credentials and blueprint, then start once.
guide.article.lite-hosting.audience: Owners of their own server configurations. Actions use current authorization.
guide.article.lite-hosting.section.prepa: Create or select a configuration in My servers and verify its host Persona ID. The account must own BFV; an API-only account cannot replace a Blaze management account.
Update the credentials as requested. Select an owned blueprint or an offered special hosting preset, then confirm the region. Keep EA cookies, passwords and secrets private.
guide.article.lite-hosting.section.start: Confirm that credentials, hosting state and blueprint are ready, complete verification and click Start once.
Wait for a room ID or a clear error. If the result is uncertain. Check the server list and your configuration before retrying, because a room may already exist.
guide.article.lite-hosting.section.manag: Open an authorized server and use available ban, unban, kick, chat or broadcast actions. Check targets and cooldowns for multi-server messages; do not resend an uncertain result. Full-client runtime settings belong in the client.
guide.article.full-hosting.title: Full client: device authorization and rebinding
guide.article.full-hosting.summary: Distinguish website sign-in, server device authorization and administrator rebinding.
guide.article.full-hosting.audience: Full-client owners. Rebinding is restricted to community administrators.
guide.article.full-hosting.section.autho: Open the server authorization link generated by the full client. Check the client name, device fingerprint, expiry and your eligible full-client servers.
Sign in as the server owner, choose the server and approve. The web page does not display client credentials; return to the client after approval.
guide.article.full-hosting.section.contr: My clients lists your own devices. Start and stop are enabled only when online capabilities allow them. Wait for the client result; pending is not success. Change runtime settings in the full client.
guide.article.full-hosting.section.rebin: Ask a community administrator to rebind from the server editor, providing the target machine code and reason. This revokes the old device, sessions and queued commands. The owner must authorize the new client. It neither closes the EA room nor transfers ownership.
guide.article.groups.title: Groups, server membership and QQ chat management
guide.article.groups.summary: Distinguish community groups from QQ chats and apply role-based management.
guide.article.groups.audience: Group members, owners and senior admins. Community-level edits need community admin permissions.
Select an authorized group in My groups and inspect its members, servers and applications. Group privileges are not community-wide admin privileges.
Submit a server application from its configuration. The authorized group owner reviews and accepts, rejects or disables it. A QQ group number is not a community group UUID.
guide.article.groups.section.qq.title: Link multiple QQ chats
guide.article.groups.section.qq.body.1: The owner generates a one-time command in the QQ bot section and sends it with an @mention in the target chat. A community group can link several chats. OpenID is a platform identifier, not a group number. Senior admins configure allowed policies; other admins may be read-only.
guide.article.groups.section.policies.bo: Choose the offered admission policy: everyone, healthy players, the local-ban exception or closed admission. Decisions use ROBOT, BFBAN and the current group policy.

Custom welcomes and keyword replies need community approval. Inactivity removal requires a complete observation window, a preview and a second confirmation; owners and admins are protected. The website cannot grant permissions unavailable from the platform.
guide.article.warmup.title: Request warmup and track tasks
guide.article.warmup.summary: Choose an authorized group and target server, then track queue, joining and leaving states.
guide.article.warmup.audience: Warmup members assigned to a group. QQ calling rules are configured separately.
Web access needs the warmup member role and group assignment. Ordinary members are checked against the live host Persona ID allowlist; ROBOT hosting registration is not required. A QQ everyone-can-call option applies only to the configured calling chat and host allowlist.
guide.article.warmup.section.task.title: Create and monitor a task
guide.article.warmup.section.task.body.1: Select a warmup group and enter the verified server Game ID. Confirm its name, requested account count and stop-at player count.
guide.article.warmup.section.task.body.2: Submit once and track the task and connected count. Queued or dispatching is not complete. Read the failure details instead of creating duplicate tasks.
guide.article.warmup.section.finish.body: After a threshold, timeout or cancellation, wait for leaving to finish. Schedules and anti-cold rules depend on permissions and scheduler availability. ROBOT Coin is a draft; this guide does not announce RC charges or rewards.
guide.article.warmup-contribution.title: Contribute warmup accounts and maintain access
guide.article.warmup-contribution.summar: Submit accounts after receiving group access and understand credential retries.
guide.article.warmup-contribution.audien: Authorized warmup members. Bulk import and node settings are admin-only.
guide.article.warmup-contribution.sectio: Ask the warmup administrator for member access and a group assignment, then add the account in that group. Contribute only accounts you may lawfully provide and that can sign in under platform rules.
Enter the requested credentials in the protected form. Secrets are write-only; follow the form instructions for preserving existing values. Never put them in cases, public chats or screenshots.
Pending or refreshing means work is queued. If EA verification is required, complete it with EA; repeatedly refreshing credentials is not a substitute.
Read the status for connection failures, cleanup or review; scheduled retries handle recovery. The enabled switch is a manual control, not a reason to delete and recreate accounts to bypass checks.

Admins must preview, deduplicate and select CSV rows before importing. Members cannot configure nodes or bulk-import. Contribution time and weekly RC payments remain proposed rules, not an enabled automatic reward system.
guide.article.reports-appeals.title: Reports, self-appeals and support cases
guide.article.reports-appeals.summary: Choose the right case type and understand website cases and bot tickets.
guide.article.reports-appeals.audience: Website case creation is currently limited to community admins and full-client owners. Other members can use the supported bot flows.
guide.article.reports-appeals.section.pr: Look up the player and confirm the Persona ID, current status and existing cases. Choose the case type if you can create web cases; otherwise use the supported bot report, self-appeal or manual-ticket flow.

Include a clear title, event time, server and reviewable evidence. Keep passwords, cookies, authorization codes and unrelated private information out of rich text. Attachments depend on supported storage channels.
guide.article.reports-appeals.section.bo: QQ, Discord and HeyChat report/self-appeal commands verify the linked community identity; appeals target your own linked player only. Manual Discord/HeyChat tickets may record platform identity before a handler adds the player. This does not bypass case authorization.
guide.article.reports-appeals.section.re: Reports may be automated only when complete career, weapon and status rules match; otherwise they need review. An anomaly label does not guarantee a ban. Appeals wait for volunteers. Keep the case ID and add evidence to the existing case rather than duplicating it.
guide.article.volunteer-tickets.title: Volunteers: claim, reply, transfer and archive
guide.article.volunteer-tickets.summary: Work within case permissions and synchronize website replies to ticket channels.
guide.article.volunteer-tickets.audience: Community volunteers and admins. Ordinary users access only their authorized cases.
Filter pending cases, verify the creator identity, player and case type, and claim before handling. A ticket channel existing does not mean a volunteer has claimed it.
The assignee may reply; other volunteers are read-only. Admins act within their permissions. Website replies are queued to the Discord or HeyChat ticket channel; queued does not mean delivered.
The current handler or an admin opens Transfer and selects an eligible volunteer. Use the paginated selector and verify identity rather than guessing from a nickname.
Enter a handover reason and confirm. Transfer changes the handler only, not the type, player or status. Reply rights follow the new handler.

After closure, messages and attachment references are archived and channels cleaned according to platform capabilities. External links can expire or be removed. Unknown or failed states are not a complete archive. Native Administrator or owner permissions may bypass channel read-only rules.
guide.article.api-access.title: Request API tokens and understand limits
guide.article.api-access.summary: Apply for scopes and quotas, claim your token once, and handle paging and rate limits.
guide.article.api-access.audience: Community integrators and approved bots. Community developers review applications.
guide.article.api-access.section.apply.b: Check whether each endpoint is public, its scopes and any additional server permission. An API token does not grant server ownership or community administrator status.
Sign in, open API access and provide the app name, purpose, eligible subject, minimum scopes and reasonable per-second/daily quotas. Submit and await review.
Claim an approved token; its plaintext is shown once. Store it in server-side secret configuration. Revoke a leaked token promptly; never place it in frontend code or a query URL.
guide.article.api-access.section.usage.b: Use the documented authentication headers and pagination. For 401/403 check the token, scope and resource authorization. For 429 honor Retry-After or back off. App quotas and the upstream EA account pool are separate controls.
guide.article.api-access.section.billing: Buying API quota with RC remains a proposal. Follow the current application limits and review outcome. Sensitive web administration may require a real website session; a token cannot replace verification or device rebinding approval.
guide.article.captcha.title: CAPTCHA, blank widgets and website updates
guide.article.captcha.summary: Troubleshoot supported CAPTCHA providers and understand verification windows.
guide.article.captcha.audience: All users. Available providers are shown by the page.
guide.article.captcha.section.blank.body: Allow the verification script time to load and check provider connectivity. Privacy or ad-blocking extensions may block it; adjust relevant rules only when you trust the site.

Try another provider offered by the page or reload and start again. GeeTest should receive input above the current dialog. Report overlays, click-through or unexpected closure with device, browser, language and error details.
guide.article.captcha.section.proof.titl: Verification passed but the action failed
guide.article.captcha.section.proof.body: Proofs expire and are bound to the current origin and action. They cannot be replayed after submission. Complete a fresh challenge after failure; a provider success alone does not mean the backend accepted the action.
guide.article.captcha.section.windows.bo: Volunteer ticket verification can last up to three hours in the same valid session. Ordinary admin actions may have a shorter window, while heavy or sensitive actions still need verification. Login, registration and recovery do not use this handling exemption.

A resource-load failure may follow a new website release. Save unsent text before refreshing. Repeated clicks on an old page are not safe retries. Only eligible developers/super admins can choose their personal verification preference.
guide.article.files.title: File storage and provider availability
guide.article.files.summary: Understand long-term and temporary storage, setup status and platform link limits.
guide.article.files.audience: Signed-in users manage their files. Provider configuration is developer-only.
guide.article.files.section.availability: Check that storage is enabled before uploading. Configured, not tested means settings exist, not that uploads or retention are verified. Unavailable storage does not fall back to the backend disk.
guide.article.files.section.providers.bo: Choose temporary storage (3 years) or long-term storage (10 years) for regular files. These are website retention periods, not guarantees from external platforms. Baidu Netdisk is for staff backups and case evidence. Only developers can upload directly; administrators can view and download evidence within their permissions.

Temporary: Discord and KOOK use dedicated servers/channels. HeyChat uses a dedicated room/text channel and the official media upload API: images become image messages and other accepted files become links. Accepted types and retention depend on the platform response; arbitrary file support is not guaranteed. Reference expiry differs from platform retention, and links can expire.
guide.article.files.section.use.title: Uploads and evidence references
guide.article.files.section.use.body.1: Choose a retention period and check file type and size limits. Only developers can choose a provider. Regular files are limited to 8 MiB each. If the result is uncertain. Check your file records before sending again.
guide.article.files.section.use.body.2: My files is scoped to your files. Anyone possessing an external temporary link may be able to access it. Avoid unrelated personal data, identify evidence sources and do not treat short-lived URLs as permanent backups.
guide.article.pc-login.title: Full-client PC web sign-in integration
guide.article.pc-login.summary: A trusted client starts browser sign-in and receives a one-time local handoff.
guide.article.pc-login.audience: Full-client developers and users. The native client must implement the protocol.
guide.article.pc-login.section.start.bod: The client must support the PC web sign-in protocol. Listen on local port 47890, prepare the session and security checks, then open the sign-in page with valid parameters. Authorization requires a request started by the client.
guide.article.pc-login.section.login.bod: Check the client request, then sign in on the community website with your password or an enabled provider and complete verification. Do not enter your community password into arbitrary local pages.
Confirm the handoff to your local client. Follow the client acknowledgement. If the browser requests local-network access, approve only this trusted client flow.
guide.article.pc-login.section.limits.bo: Callbacks are restricted to the fixed loopback destination. Arbitrary hosts, ports and callback URLs are not accepted. Web sign-in does not grant server ownership or bind a device. Follow the PC integration document to validate request parameters and the one-time authorization result.
